title: Tower of terror music discs
description: This mod adds every twilight zone tower of terror music discs to allow map makers to make even better immersive maps when rebuilding the Hollywood Tower Hotel. This project will probably receive updates, though unfrequent.
body:
This mod adds almost every Twilight zone : Tower of terror's music discs. Adds a total of 7 different music discs, and a total of 8 musics usable in commands. (one of the musics does not have an assiciated disc). More discs coming from that same ride/universe will be added in the future.

Disclaimer (because i dont know if its required here), this mod has nothing to do with the real life Twilight zone tower of terror (owned by disney) and is only a fanmade mod.

Includes musics : 
1. When the sun sets down south
2. There's No Two Ways About It
3. There's A House
4. Pyramid
5. Jungle Drums
6. Another World
8. Tip top club
9. Tower of terror birthday event/projection (commands only)
